text: The Nottingham Forest sleeve sponsor is the combined Bally's-Intralot betting and lottery group (EUR2.7bn merger, Bally's holding a 58% majority stake), per NEXT.io. Standard General/Soo Kim's control of Bally's and stated ~33% Intralot voting stake would need a source that actually states them.

source.name: NEXT.io - 'EUR 2.7bn Bally's-Intralot deal creates Athens stock exchange gaming giant'
source.quote: a landmark €2.7bn transaction that combines Bally's International Interactive with Intralot's worldwide lottery and gaming operations, forming one of the largest listed gaming companies on the Athens Stock Exchange
